provenance.quote: From April 1, 2016 to July 30, 2017 severely obese adult patients (body mass index greater than 35 kg/m2) admitted to the Medical or Surgical intensive care units of the Massachusetts General Hospital (Boston, Massachusetts) entered the study

Among patients admitted to the participating intensive care units during the study period and requiring mechanical ventilation lasting longer than 24 h (N = 1,053), 117 patients had a body mass index greater than 35 kg/m2.
admitted to the Medical or Surgical intensive care units of the Massachusetts General Hospital (Boston, Massachusetts)

Pleural pressure targeted-incremental PEEP (PEEPINCREMENTAL): PEEP progressively increased by 2 cm H2O every 60 s until the end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure equaled 0 to 2 cm H2O representing the optimal incremental PEEP.

Compared to PEEPARDSNET, at PEEPINCREMENTAL level (22 ± 3 cm H2O) lung volume increased (977 ± 708 ml), lung elastance decreased (23 ± 7 cm H2O/l), lung collapse decreased (18 ± 10%), and ventilation homogeneity increased thus rising oxygenation (251 ± 105 mmHg)
Fourteen severely obese patients (body mass index = 58.6 ± 11.0 kg/m2) matched the Berlin definition criteria for ARDS diagnosis.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all 14 patients met Berlin ARDS criteria. obese_population: enrolment required BMI > 35 kg/m2 and mean BMI 58.6 kg/m2. timing_subgroup: procedures started on average 1 [range 0-4] day after initiation of mechanical ventilation, i.e. within 48 h of intubation. ptp_target_subgroups: PEEPINCREMENTAL targeted end-expiratory Ptp 0-2 cmH2O by absolute Pes subtraction (absolute_positive_end_expiratory_ptp); PEEPDECREMENTAL targeted lowest respiratory system elastance after a recruitment maneuver without esophageal pressure (other).

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md suspects a mgh_lung_rescue cluster with florio_2020. Checks: (1) registration — this study is NCT02503241 / IRB 2015P001515; per COHORTS.md, Florio requires ARDS plus BMI above 40 and states that none of its patients participated in any ongoing MGH ARDS interventional trial, which refutes overlap; (2) enrolment — this study enrolled April 1, 2016 to July 30, 2017 at Massachusetts General Hospital; (3) eligibility — this study requires Berlin ARDS and BMI > 35. Concluded no overlap with florio_2020; also distinct from pirrone_2016 (refuted cluster per COHORTS.md).
unclear_items: outcomes[oxygenation baseline].data[0].arm_label: screening PaO2/FiO2 (150 ± 81, N = 13) precedes all crossover conditions; assigned to 'peep_ardsnet' only because the schema requires an arm label matching arms[].

outcomes[barotrauma].data[0].arm_label: post-procedure chest radiograph finding attributed to 'peep_decremental' (the level patients were ventilated at after procedures); the paper does not assign it to a condition.
population.exclusion_criteria: detailed inclusion/exclusion criteria are in Supplemental Digital Content 1, not in the main text.

intervention.balloon_calibration: the main text says positioning and inflation volume 'were verified' citing Baydur 1982 and Mojoli 2016; the exact method and acceptance criteria are in the supplement, so coded baydur_occlusion_test from the citation.

feasibility.n_placement_attempted/n_placement_successful: the paper does not explicitly report placement success counts; inferred from 'all patients completed the entire study procedures' and complete esophageal pressure data.
design.randomised: coded false because 'The order of the study procedures was not randomized'; the study is not a randomised trial.
EIT collapse and overdistension values at PEEPARDSnet appear only in figure 5 and would require digitisation.

extraction_flags.general_notes: No mortality, ventilator-free days, ICU/hospital length of stay, or successful extubation outcomes are reported; the study is purely physiologic with 24-h hemodynamic safety follow-up. One patient developed new-onset atrial fibrillation during the 24-h period after procedures, treated with amiodarone; the paper does not attribute it to the balloon or the PEEP strategy. EELV is expressed as volume increment from the PEEPARDSnet level. VD/VT rows have N = 11. No schema field exists for the EIT distribution-of-ventilation (ROI 1-4) data or for the decremental-trial stepwise PEEP/Ple trajectories (figs. 2, 4, 6); these are figure-only.
